result.title: ChatGPT Work, now powered by GPT-6 Astra
result.description:
ChatGPT Work is now powered by GPT-6 Astra—our best model for professional work.

Bring it your next big project. With Astra, ChatGPT Work better understands what you’re trying to do and pulls together the information you need from your connected apps and computer. It helps you create polished reports, presentations, and analyses faster—with more natural writing, a closer fit to your templates and style, and less cleanup.

Then hand over the busywork. With your permission, ChatGPT Work can use your desktop apps and browser much like you do—clicking, typing, and moving between screens to fill out forms, update records and trackers, and schedule meetings. Astra makes it better and faster at these tasks, even in apps that don’t have a ChatGPT integration.

ChatGPT Work with GPT-6 Astra is available to all paid ChatGPT plans in the desktop app and on chatgpt.com.

Learn more in our blog: https://openai.com/index/gpt-6-astra-next-generation-work/

result.title: Introducing GPT-Image-2.5 in the API
result.description:
Meet Sunburst and Flare, our two new GPT-Image-2.5 models. Sunburst brings sharper details, more natural lighting, and greater control across edits. Flare delivers high quality images over 50% faster. Both support transparent backgrounds for assets ranging from infographics to games.

Available now in the API.
